items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: He was the tenor player in Lou Russell's band

ctx.x: All right. So -- okay, anything else before we leave Teddy Hill?

Well, Teddy Hill was -- he was a most peculiar musician in that he wasn't a very good saxophone player. He had worked earlier with Lou Russell's band. He was the tenor player in Lou Russell's band, and then when he had this band he -- he had a good band up at the Savoy. At one time he
had Chu Berry, Dickie Wells and Bill Dillard. A very good stomp down band. One thing about him, he had rehearsals regularly, you know. Sort of a regular thing, and he'd buy arrangements, you know.
